migrationNotes: Third HHH Campaign 2 release and the ninth HHH Core Case, produced against the released Case 08 baseline 0626468629d0f9bfed65b9371e2968c43c70cd1e and the approved Blueprint.

Two separate statements were given and are recorded separately and exactly: on-screen/content/visual, "approved good and stable"; physical print, "physical print approved". They are deliberately never merged into a combined quotation. The owner supplied no browser, printer, print scale, paper, colour mode or other print method and none is claimed anywhere in this release; the instructions given before printing are not evidence of the settings actually used. Release conversion changed no printable source: content.html, presentation.css and layout-overrides.json are byte-identical to that commit, and only task-registry.js moved, to carry the lifecycle stamp, which renders nothing.

Certified release-source commit: 5429c3c81497e2da2fdf654a294ee9d9f5782404. The released task-registry.js bytes first exist at release conversion, because the lifecycle stamp is created by release conversion, so the pins identify that commit rather than the owner printable baseline. It is the first commit in this Case 09 line whose tree carries the complete released four-source byte set; the pin-resolution commit that follows inherits the same source files unchanged. This is proven by walking every commit in the feature range and testing the full released four-file byte set at each, not assumed. The two identities are recorded separately and deliberately, following the Case 03, Case 04, Case 05, Case 06, Case 07 and Case 08 precedent.

No owner-approved bundle exists and none is claimed. The release-history schema requires no bundle field, no bundle file is referenced by this release, and implementation tooling is not evidence of owner bundle approval.

The exact commit the owner approved was independently confirmed after approval with no modifications — the post-owner confirmation was read-only and changed no bytes. It proved that 0202027 was unchanged, that no descendant existed, that no remote Case 09 branch existed, that no tag or release existed, that the four owner-approved source hashes were intact, that the candidate was mechanically green, and that no source or lifecycle mutation had occurred after owner approval. Frozen game-source baseline: d9fc16baf272cb543c29cbd0c06ec85efad60be8. The Phase 1 audit baseline remains 9b8545ed6ecf98b337326390400076e36789e056, and the audit record of reference is hhh/audit/HHH_MASTER_GAME_AUDIT_v0.1.md against the approved Blueprint hhh/blueprint/HHH_CURRICULUM_BLUEPRINT_v1.0.md. The game is unmodified by this release.
Runtime case identity: C2 L2, The Seeds They Kept, Leningrad in 1941. instructionalType CORE_CASE, displayOrder 11.

Two game findings, neither a blocker. HHH-IMP-C2L2-001 is RESOLVED_VERIFIED at the current game commit: the street evidence is now an operationally required clue, the level has six required evidence clues and no insight-flagged source, and the package pins that resolution in runtimeDependency, verifies it against the shared tracker's resolution evidence, and leaves the tracker untouched. HHH-GAME-C2L2-001 is a teacher qualification, OPEN_AT_AUDITED_GAME_BASELINE by design, and the package carries it in every role: every staff-death count is printed with its source attached and qualified, and Vavilov is kept on his own strand of the chronology apart from the colleagues who kept the collection.

Eight visible tasks carry the Core Case spine, and the culminating product is a Collection Continuity Judgment rather than canonical CER. CER is declined on the ground Cases 06, 07 and 08 established: the judgment holds four separately scored obligations — what the evidence supports about continuity, the strongest links in the provenance chain, what testimony and reconstructed evidence cannot establish, and why crop genetic diversity mattered beyond the siege — which a single-claim frame cannot hold, and the Answer Key must distinguish the in-world verdict from the defensible real-history conclusion. No role renders the shared canonical CER component and no role declares a CER contract.

Task 2 is deliberately non-keyable. It records a provisional continuity test set before the documented sources arrive, there is no correct answer, and the Answer Key omits it without renumbering. The Teacher Guide carries the guidance for reading it diagnostically, and no learner page states any grading policy.

Complete in-packet no-game dossier: all six operationally required C2 L2 evidence strands are printed as Sources A to F in the order the game presents them — the besieged street, Dr. Morozov's testimony, the preservation scan, the accession ledger, the recovered Vavilov record and the Consumption Report. Campaign 2 has no level selector and no direct-launch mode, so every assessed piece of evidence exists in the learner packet and the Teacher Guide supplies both a gameplay route and a complete no-game route, in terms that make neither the reduced version.

Source estate: the Phase 1 audit is not modified. Audit sources H14 (Crop Trust, "Nikolai Vavilov: The Father of Genebanks") and H13 (VIR, "About institute") are reused, and exactly one source is certified case-locally — I. G. Loskutov, "Wartime activities of the Vavilov Institute", Proceedings on Applied Botany, Genetics and Breeding, 2021, 182(2):151-162, DOI 10.30901/2227-8834-2021-2-151-162 — as the PMO authorised. H13 is narrowed to institutional identity only: as consulted for this candidate on 2026-08-20 the page read "page under construction" and carried no siege narrative, so it certifies the Institute's present name, Federal Research Center status and continued existence and nothing else. The bounds are machine-readable in source/task-registry.js under sourceCertification, and no historical, biographical, chronological, quantitative or institutional claim appears anywhere in the package that is not on one of those lists.

Two-layer truth is structural, not editorial. Three source-status bands are marked in markup as data-evidence-layer and in printed text as a SOURCE STATUS band on every evidence object, and the non-merger rule is printed on page 1 of both learner editions: reconstructed game evidence can support reasoning inside the case but cannot establish what happened to the real collection, and a documented source can establish what happened to the real collection but cannot prove any event in the game.

Standards: seven directly assessed — C3 D2.His.1.6-8, C3 D2.His.2.6-8, C3 D3.1.6-8, C3 D3.2.6-8, CCSS RH.6-8.1, CCSS RH.6-8.7 and CCSS WHST.6-8.1 — two supporting, CCSS RH.6-8.9 and CCSS WHST.6-8.2, and one contextual science entry. No NGSS performance expectation is claimed at any status.

Declared Accessible adaptations: exactly six, and no seventh — t3-dates-supplied, t4-ends-supplied, t5-status-prelabeled, t5-modelled-row, t6-claims-supplied and t8-bounded-choice. Everything else changes the route rather than the demand. Both figures are identical in the two editions, no Accessible-only obligation exists, and edition parity is enforced structurally through editionResponseContract. The single independent-review blocker in this release line was that the Accessible Task 5 and Task 6 writing areas were compressed below their Student equivalents; the bounded remediation child closed it and the owner reviewed and printed the corrected byte set.

Regression protection retained by the release: five closed negative semantic classes — vavilovPresentAtSiege, nothingMovedAsHistory, zeroLossAsHistory, cleanProvesForged and settledDeathCount — each anchored to a named subject register, each requiring an affirmative unnegated predicate, and each paired with a positive structural requirement checked against markup, shipping negative controls the validator must flag and positive controls it must not, plus structural and exemption mutation controls. Also retained: the three-band source-status contract, the marked in-game quotation contract, the case-local source certification bounds, the two-strand chronology, the continuity chain with its LOSSES node, the Task 6 competing-record test, task-reference parity, the edition response contract, the standards lock, page identity, persistent response controls and HTML-only enforcement.

The Case09-local structural exemption mechanism is CASE09_LOCAL_MECHANISM_ACCEPTABLE and is explicitly NOT a shared-system precedent. Marked in-game quotations and reconstructed evidence objects are excused from the two historical-claim guards and from nothing else, proven by mutation controls showing the same sentence unmarked, or inside a documented card, still fires. The deferred semantic-guard recall hardening remains deferred and was not implemented during release conversion.

Visible learner provenance follows shared/visual-style-guide/amendments/STUDENT_FACING_METADATA_AND_VISUAL_HIERARCHY_v1.0.1.md: every learner-visible band is the short controlled label and nothing else, while the machine-readable evidence-layer markup is unchanged and is what validation binds to.

This release claims no SSS legacy exemption. It is a full current-contract release with frozen Student, Teacher and Answer Key DOM baselines; the Accessible DOM hash was additionally computed and compared at both trees to prove parity across all four roles.
